name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaExecution.prefix_output_law
type_text:
∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
            (O :
              OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n))
            (seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K) (ω : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k),
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => O.answer 1 a (0, r) (ω a)) →
              ∀ (N : ℕ),
                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q ≤ N →
                  (OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.literal q) (fun x => N) seed ω).1 =
                      (OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.prefix q) (fun x => N) seed ω).1 ∧
                    (OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.prefix q) (fun x => N) seed ω).2 ≤
                      (OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.literal q) (fun x => N) seed ω).2
